entities.summary: Wang Chen is a Chinese pulmonologist and physician, formerly served as vice-president of the Chinese Academy of Engineering (CAE) and president of the Peking Union Medical College. He is a member of the Chinese Hospital Association (CHA) and Chinese Medical Doctor Association (CMDA).
